name: Upgrade Modal
description: An upsell dialog drawn in its open state, built on the shadcn "Nova" preset — Stone neutrals, Blue primary, radius 0 — stated once as a token object so every colour, gap, size and type value on the card reads from the same source; the Paper and Figma originals bind the identical variables. A 200px hero carries the one non-token surface: the mesh shader from the design flattened to a linear ramp that runs indigo from the bottom-left to violet at the top-right, with a square 28px close mark pinned in its corner. Below it the header is a single row — title and a 20px primary pill held apart by space-between — with the description under both, then three feature rows whose 24px check tiles sit in a fixed lane so the copy column aligns, and a full-width primary action with a ghost dismiss centred beneath. Card edge is a 1px ring at foreground/10 rather than a border. Renders entirely on the server.

variations.name: default
variations.description: An upsell dialog in its open state on the shadcn Nova preset (Stone, Blue, radius 0). Gradient hero with a square close mark, a title-and-badge row held apart by space-between, three check-tiled feature rows in a fixed lane, and a full-width primary action with a ghost dismiss. Every value on the card reads from one token object. Static — no hooks, no motion, zero JavaScript.

props.name: title
props.description: Dialog heading. Defaults to "Upgrade to Paper Pro".

props.name: description
props.description: Line under the title, set in muted-foreground. Wraps across the full card width.

props.name: badge
props.description: Primary pill on the right of the title row. Defaults to "2 months free"; pass "" to remove it and the title keeps the full row.

props.name: features
props.description: Feature rows. Each renders a 24px check tile in a fixed lane beside a medium title and a muted description; the list grows the card.

props.name: ctaLabel
props.description: Label on the full-width primary action. Defaults to "Upgrade now · $12/mo". Drawn, not wired — the piece is a still.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Ghost action under the primary one. Defaults to "Maybe later".

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the dialog root. The card is capped at 496px wide and lays out in fixed pixels, which is the width the hero, the title/badge row and the feature lane were composed against.
